_doc: Cosmetics the Cannery hands out (ids in profile unlocks.cosmetics). 'slot' groups what the Locker equips together (one per slot). None of these change gameplay.

items.name: Gold Tooth
items.desc: Your fighter's detachable gag piece becomes Granny's old gold tooth.

items.name: Trash-Can Lid Shield
items.desc: Carried like a shield while you idle in the hub.

items.name: Replica Belt
items.desc: Worn over the shoulder on the walkout. The real one is at the cleaners.

items.name: Vintage Bellows line pack
items.desc: Barnaby, 1973 edition: more hair, more reverb.

items.name: Sign Fixer frame
items.desc: Profile frame in full GLANDCO neon.

items.name: Soaked frame
items.desc: Profile frame for a 50-bucket drill streak. Smells like it.

items.name: Sizzle
items.desc: Alternate JUICE colour for Stoke: white-hot.

items.name: Frozen Blister
items.desc: A Blister on ice. Follows you around the Cannery. Mostly sliding.

items.name: Rooftop Scarf
items.desc: Found in an old trunk on the roof. Smells like pigeons and victory.

items.name: Barnacled Electrolyte Gum
items.desc: OTC supplement variant: pulled from the harbor, still sealed. Probably.

items.name: Brackish Tonic
items.desc: OTC supplement variant with a seaweed label.

items.name: Kelp Jerky
items.desc: OTC supplement variant. Chewy. Wet. Iconic.

items.name: Rusty Liniment
items.desc: OTC supplement variant in a tin that has seen things.

items.name: Salt-Crust Lozenges
items.desc: OTC supplement variant. The crust is the flavour.

items.name: Low-Tide Protein Shake
items.desc: OTC supplement variant. Shaken by the harbor itself.

items.name: Pier Night (Chum Rush arena variant)
items.desc: Chum Rush's hidden arena variant: the pier under the dock, after dark.

items.name: Rooftop: full neon
items.desc: The Rooftop arena's night variant with every GLANDCO letter lit.
